hook: This space capsule is upside down. It has to flip itself back.
narration: This space capsule is upside down in the ocean. It has to flip itself back.
It is a test version of NASA's Orion, the capsule built to carry astronauts to the Moon.
A Coast Guard ship carried it out and lowered it into open water.
Then crews left it floating upside down in the waves.
Five bags packed on top of the capsule inflate and push it back over.
Small boats stood by to see if it would work.
outcome: The bags filled, and the capsule rolled upright in the waves.
title: Space capsule flips itself upright
description:
NASA and the U.S. Coast Guard test the Orion Crew Module Uprighting System at sea: a test capsule left upside down in open water rolls itself upright as its red bags inflate.

Footage: NASA MSFC video, via the NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/jsc2019m000397
